√śṛdh 'be defiant'
present: [1.] śárdhati etc. śárdhate etc. 
[perfect: śaśṛdhe aśīśṛdhat aśardhiṣṭa śartsyati śardhiṣyate śardhitā ]
secondary: intensive: śarīśṛdh- -- desiderative: śiśardhiṣa- śiśṛtsa- -- causative: śardháyati etc. 
derivatives: śárdha -śardhin V. śárdhya RV. śṛdhyā́ RV. śardhana C. śárdhas V.B. -śardhayitṛ C. 
Not worth dividing into two roots.
